title: The Mayor Who Was Seven Seconds Late
hook: At a town meeting, Mayor Pell answers questions before hearing them, while his reflection arrives seven seconds after he moves.
truth: A misplaced alien envoy has borrowed the mayor's public identity to request formal contact, but the body, reflection, and civic procedure are not synchronizing.

monster.name: The Misplaced Envoy
monster.instinct: To complete official first contact using whatever local authority appears most ceremonial.

countdown.label: Late Reflection
countdown.text: The mayor's reflection starts lagging behind his movements.

countdown.label: Answered Questions
countdown.text: He answers questions before anyone asks them and treats this as efficient governance.

countdown.label: Committee Forms
countdown.text: The emergency committee drafts a first-contact agenda with three contradictory motions.

countdown.label: Host Slippage
countdown.text: The real mayor's memories appear in mirrors, asking who has his hands.

countdown.label: Public Declaration
countdown.text: The envoy calls a press conference to accept Earth's surrender, friendship, or baked goods; the translation is unclear.

countdown.label: Protocol Lock
countdown.text: The envoy binds the town meeting as Earth's official reply unless stopped or corrected.

clues.text: Mirrors show the mayor seven seconds late, but photographs show two outlines at once.
The envoy becomes less evasive after accepting pie without being formally served.
The envoy treats parliamentary procedure as a binding magical ritual.
The real mayor can write short messages in fogged glass.
A direct question asked three times produces a true answer on the third attempt.
The envoy carries a star map that marks the Hayward Quarry as the local conversation table.

keeperHints: Make the town meeting absurd in texture but serious in consequence.
The envoy should be sincere and dangerous because it trusts procedure too much.
Let food and hospitality matter as practical contact tools.
revealPolicy: Reveal the envoy through reflection lag, procedural confusion, and host messages before exposing its intention.
automationSafety: Do not treat body displacement lightly for affected NPCs.
Do not make the players Earth's legal representatives unless they explicitly accept that pressure.
